summary: Assign planner to define a bounded research protocol comparing dynamic vs. static memory policies under fixed token budgets using specific benchmarks.
body: Previous loops failed to empirically compare dynamic consolidation against simple baselines (e.g., append-only Markdown) due to missing controlled experiments. The research program must now target a specific, reproducible benchmark to test if dynamic strategies outperform static ones when token costs are equal. This requires defining a strict comparison protocol with clear metrics (task success, hallucination rate) and limiting the scope to 4 sources to ensure feasibility within the current research-only phase.
